item.title: Typo3 Reference Manuals as a Chrome Extension
item.description:
My first Google Chrome extension. It’s a collection of Typo3 reference manuals compiled from typo3.org.

Useful if you have a slow or unreliable internet connection (looking at you, India), or if you prefer to stay in the browser while searching the Typo3 swx reference manuals.

I wanted to publish it on the Chrome Extension Directory, but the file is 19.86 MB and Google has a 10 MB limit. If anyone knows a workaround, let me know.
